name: Weather alerts
description: Warns you about storms on days you have plans outside. An example plugin: it uses a placeholder weather host, so it answers with demo forecasts.
author: Sara examples

settings.label: Your city
settings.tip: Used to look up the forecast, for example Austin or Lyon.

settings.label: Weather API key
settings.tip: Stored encrypted in Sara's vault; the plugin gets it when it starts. The example works without one (demo forecasts).

settings.label: Offer an umbrella to-do
settings.tip: On: on a rainy morning it asks her to add a to-do (you are asked first, every time).
